Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 07(Seven) years.
2. A satisfactory completion of similar works (Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of at least one STP or WTP) of at
least Tk 44 (Forty Four) lac under single contract over a period of 7 (Seven) years shall be required in any government, semi-
government or autonomous body.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 120(One Hundred Twenty) Lac over the best three
(3) years in the last five (5) years.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 60 (Sixty) lac.
5. The tenderer should have updated trade license, TIN and VAT certificate and incorporation certificate.
6. others qualification criteria as stated in TDS.
